reviewer: Primary, personally inspected generated images; no subagents used for this revision
repair_paragraph: 上图就是我遇到过的情况。左图的提示词一开始写了面部特写，后面却又要求露出黑色鞋子和完整双手，还详细描述了整间卧室，最后生成了全身照。我保留人物描述，改成主要拍脸、颈部和肩膀，删去鞋子、完整双手和整间房都要出现的要求。使用相同模型、种子和图片尺寸重新生成后，得到了右图。脸明显放大了，不过仍比原先要求的锁骨位置多露出一些肩胸。
grid_paragraph: 这张图排成了两行两列，格子之间有细白线。四格的发型、黑色发带、裙装和暖色房间比较接近，坐床、背身回头、坐椅子、靠墙的姿势也都能认出来。不过，右上格只拍到大腿附近，没有按要求拍到膝盖以下；左下格的双手也没完全叠在一起。我会先保留这组图，再针对这些没做准的地方继续修改。

reviews.01_full: Accepted. Complete head-to-shoe frame; TV left, bed right, wooden floor and rear door visible. Feet are closer together than requested; not used as a feet-spacing example.
reviews.02_close: Initial miss: remained full body despite close-up request. Retained as failure evidence in section 14.
reviews.03_half: Initial miss: remained full body. Superseded by 20_half_fixed.
reviews.04_high: Accepted. Clear downward view with top of head, floor and bed surface visible.
reviews.05_low: Low-angle change too weak for teaching. Superseded by 21_low_fixed.
reviews.06_side: Accepted as side-facing view, not a claim of exact 90-degree profile.
reviews.07_back: Accepted. Rear body orientation with head looking back over shoulder.
reviews.08_left: Position shift too weak. Superseded by later left-position revision.
reviews.09_seated: Accepted. Seated support, bent knees, feet on floor and hands near knees visible.
reviews.10_walk: Accepted. Staggered steps and arm movement visibly distinguish the walking pose.
reviews.11_gaze: Gaze changed but initial framing remained full body. Superseded by close comparison.
reviews.12_hairhand: Accepted for hand-contact contrast. Actual raised hand is subject's left rather than requested right; explicitly disclosed in article.
reviews.13_vague_scene: Accepted. Bedroom exists but bed spans behind subject; no TV/rear-door arrangement. Not presented as an outdoor failure.
reviews.14_knit: Material changed, but crop remained full and footwear changed. Superseded by close material comparison.
reviews.15_hardlight: Stronger direct light and wall window shadow visible; replaced with near-shot comparison for teaching.
reviews.16_warmlight: Warm lamp visible; replaced with near-shot comparison.
reviews.17_blur: Background softened; replaced with near-shot comparison.
reviews.18_grid: Accepted with disclosed deviations. Four equal panels and distinct poses present; upper-right crop ends near thigh rather than below knee. No claim of exact identity lock.
reviews.19_close_fixed: Accepted as near portrait: much larger face and shoulder/chest crop. Clavicle-only boundary not achieved; described honestly rather than relabeled exact crop.
reviews.20_half_fixed: Accepted. Upper-body/waist framing with identifiable room objects.
reviews.21_low_fixed: Accepted. Ground-level upward view, ceiling visible and bed seen from below.
reviews.22_left_fixed: Left-position change succeeded but an unrequested rug appeared. Superseded by 28_left_wood.
reviews.23_gaze_fixed: Accepted. Eyes look to image right; head angle also changes slightly. Used for gaze example, not isolated eyeball-control claim.
reviews.24_knit_fixed: Accepted. Visible ribbed knit instead of smooth satin. Neckline and small pose differences remain.
reviews.25_hard_fixed: Accepted. Harder facial light and clear window shadow on wall; not described as precise window bars across face.
reviews.26_warm_fixed: Accepted. Lamp and darker warm room visible. Day/night comparison changes several lighting attributes by design.
reviews.27_blur_fixed: Accepted. Room edges are more blurred than 20; objects remain broadly recognizable. Not claimed fully obliterated background.
reviews.28_left_wood: Accepted. Figure visibly left of center; right room space preserved; wooden floor restored. Dress folds vary, as expected from separate text-to-image outputs.

limits: These are text-to-image runs. Shared seed and descriptive anchors do not establish pixel-matched identity or exact causal isolation.
Figures resize and arrange original outputs with explanatory labels. No post-generation crop is presented as model compliance.
Prompt examples inside the prose include focused excerpts. The jobs manifest and per-run evidence retain full actual requests.
